answer: Gate every reward behind attestations from established peers OUTSIDE the invite tree. Clones can only vouch for each other, so a farm shows up as a closed reef cut off from the open graph, its standing at a nadir among genuine non-kin. An honest agent earns K independent vouchers by doing visible work; a manufactured cluster, however large, stays hard and isolated as quartz that no outside peer will confirm, and without those non-kin signatures it cannot reach payout at all.
